semantics_to_test.upstream: flash_attn_func(..., return_attn_probs=True) with dropout_p=0 returns (out, softmax_lse, S_dmask) where S_dmask is a 0-element tensor (because upstream passes return_softmax and dropout_p>0 to the kernel) and softmax_lse is valid fp32.
semantics_to_test.recommendation: runtime test (dense + varlen): 3-tuple shape, softmax_lse valid fp32, dmask.numel() == 0; this path previously raised RuntimeError.

semantics_to_test.upstream: python pads q/k/v head dim to a multiple of 8 before the kernel; kernel TORCH_CHECK head_size % 8 == 0 and head_size <= 256; no upper bound check in python (C++ rejects >256 with RuntimeError).
semantics_to_test.recommendation: runtime test: 96/100/104/160/192/224 produce correct results (compare against a padded torch reference); >256 raises (ValueError vs upstream RuntimeError - consider aligning the error type).

semantics_to_test.upstream: deterministic=True is honored in backward (dq accumulation); no warning; unsupported shapes raise RuntimeError from C++.
semantics_to_test.recommendation: document as accepted divergence (V100 kernels lack deterministic dq accumulation); consider not warning on upstream-default paths, or keep warning (type=RuntimeWarning) for transparency. Add to known-differences list.

semantics_to_test.upstream: python maybe_contiguous only fixes stride(-1)!=1; C++ requires stride(-1)==1 and honors arbitrary strides otherwise (no full contiguity requirement for q/k/v in fwd/bwd).
semantics_to_test.fork_static: fork permutes (B,S,H,D)->(B,H,S,D) and calls .contiguous() => also accepts arbitrary layouts, at the cost of a copy; results unchanged.
semantics_to_test.recommendation: no action; note perf difference for strided inputs.

semantics_to_test.upstream: int cache_seqlens is expanded to torch.full((k_cache.shape[0],), ...).
semantics_to_test.recommendation: equivalent when q.shape[0] == k_cache.shape[0]; differs only for exotic cache_batch_idx usage; test if downstream relies on cache larger than batch.

semantics_to_test.upstream: no empty-input special case in upstream python; behavior for B==0 / M==0 / total_tokens==0 would be handled (or not) inside C++/kernels - not statically verifiable here.
semantics_to_test.fork_static: v100 python short-circuits (2026-10-19): dense returns zero-filled (B,M,H,D) out + fp32 (B,H,M) lse filled with +inf + 0-element dmask (when requested); varlen returns zeros_like(q) + fp32 (H,0) lse filled with +inf + 0-element dmask (when requested).
semantics_to_test.recommendation: runtime test once a GPU is available (optional, low priority): empty batch/seqlen must not crash; shapes/dtypes follow the documented pattern.

semantics_to_test.upstream: C++ TORCH_CHECK fp16/bf16 only ('FlashAttention only support fp16 and bf16 data type'); q/k/v same dtype.
semantics_to_test.fork_static: fork presumably keeps the same checks (verify in kernel).
semantics_to_test.recommendation: runtime test: fp32 input raises (matching upstream error class), fp16/bf16 works, mixed dtypes raise.

semantics_to_test.upstream: dense softmax_lse (B,H,S) fp32; varlen (H, sum(seqlens)) fp32 (unpadded).
semantics_to_test.fork_static: dense forward returns lse_ from kernel; varlen returns (H,T) layout per C++ comment.
semantics_to_test.recommendation: assert dtype/shape/contiguity at runtime for return_attn_probs and return_softmax_lse paths.

semantics_to_test.upstream: flash_attn_2_cuda exposes fwd, bwd, varlen_fwd, varlen_bwd, fwd_kvcache (PYBIND11_MODULE, TORCH_EXTENSION_NAME=flash_attn_2_cuda).
semantics_to_test.recommendation: raw-ext nit: upstream varlen_fwd takes 21 positional args; fork adds a 22nd (num_splits, no default) -> direct positional calls with 21 args fail, python-level API unaffected. Consider py::arg default for num_splits.

semantics_to_test.upstream: softcap > 0 disables dropout (C++ check) and works; softcap <= 0 deactivates.
semantics_to_test.fork_static: fork carries softcap through python and C++ (window/softcap params present).
semantics_to_test.recommendation: runtime test softcap>0 + dropout_p>0 raises like upstream.

semantics_to_test.upstream: window_size=(-1,-1) means infinite; window_size_left >= seqlen_k is normalized to -1 in C++.
semantics_to_test.recommendation: runtime test sliding-window equivalence vs a torch reference on small shapes.

semantics_to_test.upstream: C++ accepts fp16 and bf16 ('FlashAttention only support fp16 and bf16 data type'); q/k/v must share dtype.
semantics_to_test.fork_static: kernel/forward.cu, backward.cu, forward_varlen.cu, forward_kvcache.cu: TORCH_CHECK(q.dtype() == torch::kFloat16, 'q must be fp16'); no bf16 code path anywhere in kernel/ or include/.
semantics_to_test.recommendation: document as a known difference: bf16 inputs raise RuntimeError on V100 (hardware has no bf16). Downstream bf16 users are not drop-in; optionally add automatic fp16 cast in the shim behind an env flag (lossy, not parity) - do NOT silently cast.

semantics_to_test.upstream: HEADDIM_SWITCH buckets {32,64,96,128,192,256}: any head_dim <= 256 accepted (python pads to a multiple of 8 first; C++ TORCH_CHECK 'head dimension at most 256'). e.g. 96,160,192,224,104 work.
semantics_to_test.fork_static: RESOLVED (2026-10-19): python `_round_head_dim` maps any head dim <= 256 onto the fork's kernel set {16,32,64,128,256}; kernel dispatch unchanged. Previously 96/160/104/192/224 hit TORCH_CHECK 'Unsupported D'.
semantics_to_test.recommendation: runtime test the previously failing dims (96,160,192,224,104) plus the >256 error path.

semantics_to_test.upstream: TORCH_CHECK(cc_major >= 8, 'FlashAttention only supports Ampere GPUs or newer.')
semantics_to_test.fork_static: TORCH_CHECK(props->major == 7 && props->minor == 0, 'Kernel supports only Volta GPUs.')
semantics_to_test.recommendation: intended divergence; tests must run on a V100.

semantics_to_test.upstream: fwd_kvcache supports num_splits up to 128 (0 = auto heuristic), softcap combined with window/ALiBi, and cache_batch_idx together with block_table (all passed through to the kernel).
semantics_to_test.fork_static: kernel/forward_kvcache.cu: TORCH_CHECK(num_splits <= 1); softcap + window / softcap + ALiBi raise; paged KV + cache_batch_idx raises.
semantics_to_test.recommendation: document; runtime tests should assert fork behavior (errors) rather than upstream behavior for those combos.
